q: The spectrum of the one-shot channel coding problem is captured by the information spectrum (Han-Verdú). The ε-capacity is defined via the limsup and liminf of the empirical mutual information. For ergodic channels:
opts: The ε-capacity equals 0 for all ε < 1
The ε-capacity equals C (the ergodic channel capacity) for all 0 < ε < 1
The ε-capacity equals the entropy rate of the channel output
exp: Information spectrum approach (Han-Verdú 1993): the ε-capacity C_ε = liminf_{n} (1/n) log M*(n,ε) equals the spectral inf-mutual information rate for stationary ergodic channels—which equals the ergodic capacity C for all ε ∈ (0,1). The power of the information spectrum method is treating non-ergodic channels.
